data.name: Wilt
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Old English word wiltan, meaning to will or to want. The name Wilt signifies a person who is willing, resilient, and determined. This name has Germanic origins and is used primarily in the English-speaking world.

His name and legacy continue to inspire and intrigue people globally.
data.spiritual_significance: The name Wilt has spiritual significance in that it represents a desire to strive towards one's goals and to be willing to put in the effort required to achieve them. This name also embodies resilience and determination, reminding us to keep pushing forward despite the challenges and adversities we may encounter in life. Ultimately, the name Wilt invites us to tap into our inner strength and willpower to live our best lives and fulfill our divine purpose.
